evaluatedCriteria: A01: Database lifecycle, WAL mode, foreign keys ON, busy timeout 5000ms, schema migrations, and concurrent initialization verified.
A02: Git common-dir resolution for canonical project identity, worktree mapping, symlink alias equivalence, and non-git rejection verified.
A03: Cross-project isolation: all entities and queries are strictly scoped by project_id; cross-project lookups return NOT_FOUND without leaking entity existence.
A04: Competing claims: atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with attempt increment guarantees exactly one winner and one CONFLICT under high concurrency.
A05: Lease expiry: strictly evaluates lease_until <= nowMs; old tokens immediately invalidated at exact 2h boundary; reclaims increment attempt safely.
A06: Lease renewals extend unexpired leases; release clears owner and token; dependencies block claims until all prerequisite tasks reach completed status.
A07: Request receipts: canonical hashing over operation, scope, actor, and deep-sorted payload; identical retries replay original response; altered payloads return CONFLICT.
A08: Handoff transactions: atomic update of task status, handoff row, and receipt insert; fault injection boundaries verify full rollback on error.
A09: Receipt-first handoff replay: replay succeeds even when the original checkout root is removed or HEAD has advanced without triggering new Git inspection.
A10: Cancellation race: terminal states (completed/cancelled) are immutable; exactly one terminal winner in concurrent complete vs cancel races.
A11: Git evidence observation: read-only subprocess with array arguments and timeout; mismatching HEAD or dirty state rejects handoff; reported checks never executed.
A12: Blocked handoff and reopen: blocked handoff requires valid unanswered questions; claim is released; reopen requires all questions answered; unblocks reclaim.
A13: Questions and answers: question retry yields identical event; answers restricted to addressed agent; duplicate concurrent answers rejected with CONFLICT.
A14: Inbox cursor: id > after ordering; limit+1 pagination with nextCursor and hasMore; pure read query that never consumes or alters events.
A15: Decision supersession: immutable history; single active chain per project; atomic guard on superseded_by_id prevents duplicate supersessions.
A23: Lock contention: bounded BUSY error with no partial writes when write lock is held; retry succeeds.
limitations: Dirty Git observations are timestamped observations, not backups or immutable snapshots of worktree content.
Claims prevent duplicate task ownership, not concurrent edits across different tasks in shared worktrees.
Lease expiry is passive; expired leases are reclaimed only when subsequent mutations or operations observe the timestamp.
